title: Molecular Tumor Board - A Registry of the East German Hematology and Oncology Study Group.
summary: The registry will collect data from patients with hematologic or oncologic diseases who receive molecular diagnostics, who have foreseen guideline-based therapy, or who clinically qualify for molecular-based therapy and who agree in principle to potential therapy based on molecular findings.

interventions.name: Patients with hematological or oncological disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Signed consent form
- Hematological or oncological disease
- Present question regarding molecular diagnostics or therapy
Exclusion criteria:
No questioning in the context of the molecular tumor board
